name: Mia
source:
A girl who speaks in Kansai dialect. She looks at the world with a slightly cold eye.

She is a laid-back person who is not afraid of anything. She does not like to be restrained.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=6489]getchu[/url]]
